info.title: AudaConnect
info.description: AudaConnect. You can use this Swagger page to test the API. You will need to authenticate either at the top of the page for multiple scopes or clicking on the authentication status image on each operation. You will need to use your supplied Client Application ID during when selecting scopes. AudaConnect API Build Version: 2.25.26048.2

get.summary:
Retrieves a list of assessments for the logged in user, ordered by the most recently updated first.
Note: the list is limited to a maximum of 100 if no filter criterium is supplied.
The optional FilterId and userParameterValue will be supplied by Audatex, the operational team can advise on existing
filters or set up new ones if required.
This method does not use the application default filter.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: Optionally filter the results with a specified filter criterium.

parameters.name: userParameterValue
parameters.description: user filter parameters

post.summary: Creates a new shell assessment.

400.description: The input data is invalid or not understood

get.summary:
Retrieves a list of assessments for the logged in user, ordered by the most recently updated first.
Note: the list is limited to a maximum of 100 if no filter criterium is supplied.
The optional FilterId and userParameterValue will be supplied by Audatex, the operational team can advise on existing
filters or set up new ones if required.
This method does not use the application default filter.
Compared to the /assessments endpoint, this endpoint has performance improvements and the return object contains more fields.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: Optionally filter the results with a specified filter criterium.

parameters.name: userParameterValue
parameters.description: user filter parameters, only invoked if a filterId is supplied

post.summary:
Retrieves a list of assessments for the logged in user based upon the values in the search parameters supplied.
Note: each set of search parameters will be applied to the result set that came before it.
This method will use the default application filter, if one has been set up for the application.
Valid FieldName in the Search Parameters are any of the elements in the assessment summary return object, for example :
AssessmentNumber,Originator, CreationDate or Registration

parameters.name: searchParameters
parameters.description: A list of search parameters.

post.summary:
Retrieves a list of assessments for the logged in user based upon the values in the search parameters supplied.
Assessments will only be returned if they match all specified parameters, null and blank parameters are ignored.
The LastUpdated range is restricted to 30 days
This method will use the default application filter, if one has been set up for the application.
